docs.message:
docs(pdt42): portray the entity-roles (D2)

## Intent

Describe for every peer role what drives it and which gains it seeks today, independent of lernapps.net. The motivations (D3) and the platform's value propositions build on these portraits.

## Key changes

- E2 portrays all six peer roles: app creators, adopting adults, students, teacher platforms, social media and AI assistants. Each portrait has context, potential, goals, pressures and the convenience, reach and value gains the role seeks today.
- Each portrait has its Entity-Role Portrait canvas next to the entity.
- The prose of each role names the items that are still assumptions.
- AI assistants seek a working app with fewer iterations and want to build apps that can easily be used. The text notes that lernapps.net plans to serve this with instructions and scaffolding.
- Social media stays minimal; its potential is spreading apps by recommendation, as observed in E2.
- The development plan marks D2 done and adds KD-11.
